name: How long does it take to complete a home addition project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home addition depends on its scope and local permitting processes. A smaller addition might take 3-6 months from design to completion, while larger or more complex projects could take 8-12 months or longer. Factors such as design changes, material availability, and inspection schedules can also influence the overall duration. We provide a projected timeline during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Completion times vary, generally ranging from 3-12 months, depending on the project's size and complexity.
